prompt: Why has the organizer changed how visitors record a tile?
promptZh: 主辦人為何更改訪客記錄磁磚的方式？

options.text: The pencil rubbings were too dark to read.
options.zh: 鉛筆拓印太黑，看不清楚。
options.whyZh: 沒有說之前拓印太黑；今天的問題是牆面潮濕。
因為牆面濕，這次才把鉛筆拓印換成拍照。

options.text: The booklet now uses only written descriptions.
options.zh: 小冊子現在只用文字描述。
options.whyZh: 志工會用小冊子比對邊框，沒有說冊子改為純文字。

options.text: The tiles have been moved to a different street.
options.whyZh: 仍從人行道拍牆上的磁磚，沒有搬移的說法。

explanationZh: 因為牆面濕，這次才把鉛筆拓印換成拍照。
evidence: We usually ask you to make a pencil rubbing of one of the old tiles, but the walls are wet. Use a photo instead.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We usually ask you to make a pencil rubbing of one of the old tiles, but the walls are wet. Use a photo instead.
